profile.name: Full name

profile.closeAccountDesc: Before you do this, please note that account deletion is irreversible.
profile.closeDialogTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
profile.closeDialogDesc: This action cannot be undone. If you delete your account:
profile.closeDialogPoint1: Your saved addresses, saved cards and wishlist are erased.
profile.closeDialogPoint2: Your past orders stay in our accounting records, as the law requires, but you will no longer see them here.
profile.closeDialogPoint3: You are signed out on every device, and this cannot be undone.

passwordDialog.title: Change your password
passwordDialog.description: You will stay signed in here. Other devices are signed out unless you choose otherwise.
passwordDialog.successDescription: Use your new password next time you sign in.

twoFactorDialog.enableDescription: Confirm your password to begin. You will then scan a code with your authenticator app.
twoFactorDialog.scanTitle: Scan this with your authenticator app
twoFactorDialog.scanDescription: Open Google Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis or similar and scan the code. If you cannot scan, enter the key by hand.
twoFactorDialog.codeDescription: Enter the code your app shows to finish turning 2FA on.
twoFactorDialog.backupDescription: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe — this is the only time they are shown.
twoFactorDialog.disableDescription: Your account will be protected by your password alone. Confirm your password to continue.
twoFactorDialog.enabledDescription: You will be asked for a code from your app when you sign in.
twoFactorDialog.disabledDescription: Your account is protected by your password alone.
twoFactorDialog.wrongCode: That code is not correct. Check your app and try again.

profile.closeDialogRecentSignIn: You signed in with Google or GitHub, so no password is needed. If this fails, sign in again and retry.
